headline.title: The best AI dictation apps, tested and ranked
headline.summary: A recent evaluation of AI dictation apps highlights their effectiveness for tasks such as email responses, note-taking, and coding via voice commands. The article ranks various apps based on their performance and usability.

articles.title: Musk v. Altman week 1: Elon Musk says he was duped, warns AI could kill us all, and admits that xAI distills OpenAI’s models
articles.summary: In the first week of the trial between Elon Musk and OpenAI, Musk claimed he was misled by CEO Sam Altman and president Greg Brockman into funding the company. He also expressed concerns about the potential dangers of AI, stating it could pose a significant threat to humanity.

articles.title: Disneyland Now Uses Face Recognition on Visitors
articles.summary: Disneyland has implemented face recognition technology to enhance visitor experiences and streamline entry processes. In related news, the NSA is testing Anthropic's Mythos Preview for vulnerability assessment, and a Finnish teenager faces charges linked to the Scattered Spider hacking incidents.

articles.title: TRUST: A Framework for Decentralized AI Service v.0.1
articles.summary: The article presents TRUST, a new framework designed to enhance the reliability of Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) and Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) in high-stakes environments by addressing limitations of centralized approaches. TRUST aims to improve robustness, scalability, transparency, and privacy in AI service verification.

articles.title: Web2BigTable: A Bi-Level Multi-Agent LLM System for Internet-Scale Information Search and Extraction
articles.summary: Web2BigTable is a bi-level multi-agent large language model system designed to enhance internet-scale information search and extraction by addressing the dual demands of deep reasoning and structured aggregation. The system aims to improve performance on both breadth-oriented tasks, which require schema-aligned outputs, and depth-oriented tasks that involve coherent reasoning across complex search paths.

articles.title: SpatialGrammar: A Domain-Specific Language for LLM-Based 3D Indoor Scene Generation
articles.summary: SpatialGrammar is a newly proposed domain-specific language designed to improve the generation of interactive 3D indoor scenes from natural language using large language models (LLMs). It aims to address spatial errors and collisions in existing methods by providing a more effective representation of 3D spatial relationships and physical constraints.

articles.title: Intent2Tx: Benchmarking LLMs for Translating Natural Language Intents into Ethereum Transactions
articles.summary: The article introduces Intent2Tx, a new benchmark designed to evaluate Large Language Models (LLMs) in translating natural language user intents into accurate Ethereum transactions. This benchmark includes 29,921 single-step and 1,575 multi-step instances, based on extensive analysis of 300 days of Ethereum mainnet data.

articles.title: D3-Gym: Constructing Real-World Verifiable Environments for Data-Driven Discovery
articles.summary: D3-Gym is a newly introduced dataset designed to support data-driven discovery in scientific research by providing 565 tasks derived from 239 real-world scientific repositories. This initiative aims to enhance the capabilities of language models and agents by offering verifiable environments that accurately represent scientific tasks.

articles.title: Learning-to-Explain through 20Q Gaming: An Explainable Recommender for Cybersecurity Education
articles.summary: The article introduces a novel educational framework called "Learning to Explain Cybersecurity with Q20 Game," which utilizes explainable AI to improve interactivity and effectiveness in cybersecurity training. This approach addresses the limitations of traditional learning methods by offering a more intuitive and adaptive learning experience.

articles.title: Reconstruction by Generation: 3D Multi-Object Scene Reconstruction from Sparse Observations
articles.summary: The article presents RecGen, a generative framework designed for the probabilistic joint estimation of object and part shapes, along with their poses, from sparse RGB-D images. This approach addresses the challenge of accurately reconstructing complex multi-object scenes, which is essential for advancements in robotics and computer vision.

articles.title: Lightweight Distillation of SAM 3 and DINOv3 for Edge-Deployable Individual-Level Livestock Monitoring and Longitudinal Visual Analytics
articles.summary: Researchers have developed a lightweight distillation of the SAM 3 and DINOv3 models to enhance individual-level livestock monitoring while ensuring compatibility with commodity edge accelerators. This approach significantly reduces the model size from 446M parameters to 40.66M, enabling more efficient deployment in precision livestock farming applications.

articles.title: When 2D Tasks Meet 1D Serialization: On Serialization Friction in Structured Tasks
articles.summary: The article discusses the challenges posed by the serialization of structured inputs into 1D token sequences in large language models (LLMs), a process termed "serialization friction." It highlights how this linearization can complicate tasks that rely on explicit 2D structures, affecting row-column alignment and local neighborhood representations.
